facts.text: For over 60 years, the resort has offered a destination in Fort Lauderdale.
facts.excerpt: For over 60 years, the resort has offered a timeless destination in Fort Lauderdale.

facts.text: Pier Sixty-Six describes itself as a gathering place for boaters, dreamers and adventurers.
facts.excerpt: Experience a gathering place for boaters, dreamers and adventurers.

facts.text: Zenova Spa & Wellness at Pier Sixty-Six is a 13,000-square-foot spa.
facts.excerpt: our 13,000-square-foot spa oasis at Pier Sixty-Six

facts.text: Zenova has treatment rooms, a Couples Spa Suite, a full-service salon and the Co-Ed Via Aquae.
facts.excerpt: Zenova features thoughtfully curated spaces—including nine luxury treatment rooms, a Couples Spa Suite, a full-service salon and the Co-Ed Via Aquae

facts.text: The Ceremonial Sauna is inspired by Europe's Aufguss saunas and offers guided rituals led by a traditional Sauna-Meister, with sound therapy and aromas.
facts.excerpt: Inspired by the traditions of Europe’s esteemed Aufguss Saunas, our Ceremonial Sauna blends sound therapy, opulent aroma-infused indulgences and guided rituals led by a traditional Sauna-Meister.

facts.text: The spa's Snow Room is kept at 10 to 14 degrees Fahrenheit and gives off alpine forest scents; the hotel calls it the region's first authentic Snow Room.
facts.excerpt: As the region's first authentic Snow Room, this transportive and custom room maintains a crisp 10 to 14°F, while emitting soothing alpine forest scents.

facts.text: The Sensory Shower combines hot and cold therapy, chromotherapy, aromatherapy and oxygenation.
facts.excerpt: A dynamic experience delivering a powerful combination of hot and cold therapy, chromotherapy, aromatherapy and oxygenation.

facts.text: The Vitality Pool is Zenova's signature therapeutic pool.
facts.excerpt: Zenova’s signature therapeutic pool warms the body, stimulating the lymphatic system.

facts.text: Zenova Spa & Wellness is open exclusively to resort guests and club members.
facts.excerpt: Zenova Spa & Wellness is currently available exclusively to Pier Sixty-Six resort guests and club members.

facts.text: Guests must be at least 18 years old to book spa services.
facts.excerpt: Guests must be at least 18 years old to book spa services.

facts.text: The Technogym-powered Resort Fitness Center is open 24/7 for resort guests and club members, with a dedicated Movement Studio for wellness classes.
facts.excerpt: The Technogym-powered Resort Fitness Center is located on the 3rd floor and is available 24/7 for resort guests and club members.

facts.text: Scheduled wellness and fitness classes range from yoga and meditation to Pilates and strength training.
facts.excerpt: scheduled wellness and fitness classes ranging from yoga and meditation to Pilates and strength training

facts.text: The weekly schedule includes a Floating Morning Meditation in the Adult Pool.
facts.excerpt: Floating Morning Meditation 8 AM - 8:30 AM Adult Pool

facts.text: The Pier Explorers Kids' Club blends play, learning and exploration, while parents can relax by the pool or enjoy water sports.
facts.excerpt: While kids embark on exciting adventures, parents can relax by the pool or enjoy water sports—kid-free—knowing their little ones are in great hands.

facts.text: Pier Explorers daily experiences include hands-on art and STEM activities and imaginative play.
facts.excerpt: From hands-on art and STEM activities to imaginative play, each day offers something new to discover.

facts.text: A Poolside Kids Club runs at the poolside cabanas on certain days.
Childcare through partner itavi is available Monday to Friday for children 3 months and up.
facts.excerpt: Available Monday – Friday only, for children 3 months and up.
